    19|
    20|# Extract phone verification into a separate Action
    21|
    22|## Scope of extraction
    23|
    24|From [porg_events_consumer.py](billing/yandex_pay_admin/yandex_pay_admin/taskq/porg_events_consumer.py), extract only what concerns **phone validation**:
    25|
    26|- `InvitePhoneVerdict` enum (lines 68-72)
    27|- `_validate_invite_phone` (lines 164-184) -- blackbox call
    28|- `_resolve_invite_phone_verdict` (lines 186-200) -- orchestration
    29|- `_log_phone_verdict` (lines 202-217) -- logging of verdict
    30|- `_was_member_before_invite` (lines 249-265) -- storage check
    31|
    32|**Stays in the worker:**
    33|
    34|- `_remove_user_from_partner` (lines 219-247) -- consequence of mismatch, not verification itself; also depends on `_should_edit_user_roles` which is used by 3 other handlers
    35|
    36|## 1. New file: `core/actions/invite/validate_phone.py`
    37|
    38|Create `ValidateInvitePhoneAction(BaseDBAction[InvitePhoneVerdict])`:
    39|
    40|- `**__init__`**: accepts `uid: int` and `invite: Invite`
    41|- `**handle()**`: returns `InvitePhoneVerdict`
    42|  - Calls `_check_phone_binding()` via `self.clients.blackbox.phone_bindings` (fixes current antipattern of manual `InteractionClients` creation)
    43|  - Calls `_was_member_before_invite()` via `self.storage`
    44|  - Logs the verdict (absorbs `_log_phone_verdict` logic)
    45|
    46|Pattern follows existing actions in the same directory, e.g. [revoke_invite.py](billing/yandex_pay_admin/yandex_pay_admin/core/actions/invite/revoke_invite.py) which uses `self.clients` and `self.storage`.
    47|
    48|## 2. Update worker: `taskq/porg_events_consumer.py`
    49|
    50|In `do_accept_invite` (lines 310-322), replace the inline phone verification block:
    51|
    52|```python
    53|if invite.phone:
    54|    verdict = await ValidateInvitePhoneAction(uid=int_uid, invite=invite).run()
    55|
    56|    if verdict == InvitePhoneVerdict.UNAVAILABLE:
    57|        raise RuntimeError(...)
    58|    if verdict == InvitePhoneVerdict.MISMATCH:
    59|        await self._remove_user_from_partner(storage, invite.partner_id, int_uid)
    60|        return
    61|    if verdict == InvitePhoneVerdict.MISMATCH_EXISTING_MEMBER:
    62|        return
    63|```
    64|
    65|Remove from the worker class:
    66|
    67|- `_validate_invite_phone`
    68|- `_resolve_invite_phone_verdict`
    69|- `_log_phone_verdict`
    70|- `_was_member_before_invite`
    71|
    72|Remove from module level:
    73|
    74|- `InvitePhoneVerdict` enum (moved to the action file)
    75|
    76|Update imports: add `ValidateInvitePhoneAction`, `InvitePhoneVerdict`; remove unused `InteractionClients`, `normalize_phone`, `phone_bindings_candidates`, `PhoneBindingType`.
    77|
    78|## 3. New test file: `tests/unit/core/actions/invite/test_validate_phone.py`
    79|
    80|Unit tests for the action in isolation, following the pattern of [test_revoke_invite.py](billing/yandex_pay_admin/yandex_pay_admin/tests/unit/core/actions/invite/test_revoke_invite.py) (`pytestmark = pytest.mark.usefixtures('setup_interactions_tvm')`).
    81|
    82|Test cases:
    83|
    84|- **MATCH**: phone binding exists for the given uid/phone
    85|- **MATCH with normalization**: phone has different formatting but normalizes to the same number
    86|- **MISMATCH**: phone binding belongs to different uid or number
    87|- **MISMATCH_EXISTING_MEMBER**: mismatch but user was member before the invite
    88|- **UNAVAILABLE**: blackbox raises an exception
    89|- **Empty phone candidates**: `phone_bindings_candidates` returns empty list
    90|
    91|## 4. Existing worker tests: no changes
    92|
    93|The 5 phone tests in `TestDoAcceptInvite` class (lines 748-926 of [test_porg_events_worker.py](billing/yandex_pay_admin/yandex_pay_admin/tests/unit/taskq/test_porg_events_worker.py)) remain as-is. They test the full flow through the worker and serve as end-to-end coverage. They mock `AbstractBlackBoxClient.phone_bindings` which will still be called transitively via the action.
    94|
    95|## Build system
    96|
    97|No `ya.make` changes needed: both `ALL_PY_SRCS(RECURSIVE core)` and `ALL_PYTEST_SRCS(RECURSIVE .)` already cover new files automatically.
